name: split on the attribute that most reduces label entropy
mechanism: at each node choose the attribute whose split most reduces the entropy of the labels, partition the examples by its values, and recurse until nodes are pure or no attributes remain

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'ID3 algorithm (Iterative Dichotomiser 3)' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: use heuristic to generate small decision trees
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'C4.5 algorithm': an extension to ID3

fails_when: greedy splits miss interactions; overfits without pruning
